subject.title: feat(agents): Swarm core — collector spawn, agents_wait, structured output, caps (gated)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this broad persisted Swarm core/config/protocol contract now, or require a narrower owner-approved experimental seam under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110325 first?
rationale: This is a new core capability with public configuration, gateway fields, persistent state, and follow-on surfaces; code review cannot determine the intended long-term product and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow v1 core seam
options.body: Confirm the intended public configuration, persistence, and protocol contract, then require the preflight repair and real runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Split the proposal
options.body: Keep only the smallest approved collector primitive in this PR and move additional configuration, UI, and harness-facing contract work into separately reviewed follow-ups.

options.title: Keep direction in the program issue
options.body: Pause this implementation until the Swarm product boundary is explicitly accepted in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110325.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow v1 core seam
recommendation.body: Confirm the intended public configuration, persistence, and protocol contract, then require the preflight repair and real runtime proof before merge.
